newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley details IBM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley details IBM.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Steve Milunovich confirmed that he expected the stock of International Business Machines Corp to see a price correction of "perhaps 10 percent or more," but added that he would "buy aggressively" at that point.
-- "We believe the stock is due for a correction because the price ran ahead of the earnings and there is no near-term catalyst," Milunovich said in a published note.

-- The Morgan Stanley analyst forecast that IBM's first quarter earnings per share would be weighed down by weak European results, lower DRAM pricing and a negative impact from translating overseas currencies into U.S. dollars.
-- "Comparisons should improve after that, with the stock acting better," he said, adding that, "Our target price is $185 following price weakness."
-- He also said he cut his 1997 earnings estimate on International Business Machines Corp to $12.55 from $12.75 per share.
